KeyValueStore/MCKVsnap.cfg.detail: The upstream cfg declares SYMMETRY alongside a PROPERTY that requires the genuine liveness checker. TLC applies the orbit quotient anyway, which is unsound for temporal properties; TY soundly refuses it and explores the full space, so the two tools perform different work and exact generated-work parity is unreachable on the upstream cfg. BOTH tools run this frozen variant, which removes only the SYMMETRY stanza and preserves every other byte. Verified exact parity after the change.

verified_parity.note: identical counts from BOTH TLC and TY on this variant
